youtube_title: Why Apps Use the RED DOT on You 🔴 #Shorts
youtube_description:
That red notification badge is designed to grab you: red reads as urgent, and a number feels like an unfinished task.

Try this: turn off badge counts for every app except the essentials in your notification settings.

#samebro #phoneaddiction #notifications #psychology #shorts
instagram_caption:
Picked up the phone to check the time... 20 min gone? 🔴

That red dot is DESIGN, not an accident.

Turn off badges for non-essential apps. Thank me later 😌

Send this to the friend whose WhatsApp always shows 999+ 👇
